chunks.text: Check-in at Aurel Algarve is from 15:00 and check-out is by 12:00. Luggage can be stored before check-in and after check-out, and guests may use the pools, spa and beach from arrival; changing rooms are in the spa. Reception is open 24 hours.

Aurel Algarve has two outdoor pools (one heated and one for children), a fitness room open 06:00 to 22:00, a spa with treatment rooms and a thermal area, two tennis courts, direct beach access and complimentary Wi-Fi throughout. Breakfast is served 07:30 to 11:00. The restaurant and pool bar serve all day.
Free parking on site for all guests, with electric charging at no extra cost. A car is useful for the western beaches; the concierge can arrange a rental delivered to the hotel.

Dogs up to 20 kg are welcome in Garden Rooms at EUR 40 per night, maximum one per room, and may use the dog-friendly beach 10 minutes' walk away. Dogs are not accepted in Sea View Rooms or Family Suites and are not admitted to the pool areas or restaurant. Other animals are not accepted except certified assistance animals, which stay free.
A private transfer from Faro airport is EUR 110 per car for up to three guests, about 60 minutes; a minivan for up to six is EUR 160. Confirmed by the concierge once the flight number is received.

Spa treatments can be pre-booked by the concierge up to the day before arrival. Guests under 16 are not admitted to the thermal area. Treatments cancelled with less than 24 hours' notice are charged in full.

The concierge recommends Dom Henrique (seafood in the old town, 10 minutes by taxi), Avenida (modern Portuguese on the marina) and O Camilo above Praia do Camilo for lunch. Tables are booked by the concierge.

Children of all ages are welcome. Family Suites sleep two adults and up to three children; cots fit in every room type. A kids' club runs 09:30 to 17:30 daily from June to September for ages 4 to 12, free of charge, and the children's pool is lifeguarded in July and August. Babysitting with 24 hours' notice.

Four Garden Rooms and two Family Suites are step-free with roll-in showers; all public areas are level or ramped. The beach is reached by a ramp and a beach wheelchair is available on request. Access needs are recorded in a restricted trace to front office so the right room is blocked before arrival.

Check-in at Aurel Amalfi is from 15:00 and check-out is by 11:00. Luggage can be stored before check-in and after check-out, and guests may use the pool, spa and restaurant from arrival. Porters carry luggage from the road; the hotel is reached by stairs or the funicular lift. Reception is open 24 hours.

Aurel Amalfi has an outdoor pool, a fitness room open 06:00 to 22:00, a spa with treatment rooms and a thermal area, a terrace restaurant and bar, and complimentary Wi-Fi throughout. Breakfast is served 07:30 to 11:00 on the terrace. The hotel closes from November to March.

No parking at the hotel. A partner garage in Positano charges EUR 50 per day and the concierge reserves a space with the registration number. We recommend arriving without a car; the coast road is slow and narrow in summer.

Dogs up to 10 kg are welcome in Classic Rooms at EUR 45 per night, maximum one per room. Dogs are not admitted to the pool terrace or restaurant. Other animals are not accepted except certified assistance animals, which stay free.

A private transfer from Naples airport is EUR 220 per car for up to three guests, about 90 minutes; a minivan for up to six is EUR 320. Confirmed by the concierge once the flight number is received. From April to October the ferry from Naples to Positano takes 90 minutes and the concierge can book seats.

Spa treatments can be pre-booked by the concierge up to the day before arrival. Guests under 16 are not admitted to the thermal area. Treatments cancelled with less than 24 hours' notice are charged in full.

The concierge recommends La Sponda (one Michelin star, candlelit, 5 minutes' walk), Da Adolfo (beach seafood reached by boat shuttle) and Chez Black on the beach. Tables are booked by the concierge; in summer allow a week for La Sponda.

All Sea View Rooms and Panorama Suites face the sea with a private balcony or terrace. Classic Rooms face the village or garden. The view category is guaranteed; the specific room is allocated on the day of arrival.

Children of all ages are welcome. Cots fit in Sea View Rooms and Panorama Suites but not in Classic Rooms. The pool and terraces are unsupervised and have sheer drops behind railings, so young children need an adult outdoors.

The hotel is built into the cliff and reached by a funicular lift from the road; inside, every level is served by lifts. One Sea View Room is step-free with a roll-in shower. Positano itself is almost entirely steps. Access needs are recorded in a restricted trace to front office.

Check-in at Aurel Athens is from 15:00 and check-out is by 12:00. Luggage can be stored before check-in and after check-out, and guests may use the fitness room and rooftop from arrival. Reception is open 24 hours.

Aurel Athens has a fitness room open 24 hours, complimentary Wi-Fi throughout, a restaurant and a rooftop bar facing the Acropolis, open 17:00 to 01:00. Breakfast is served 07:00 to 10:30 on the rooftop in summer. There is no swimming pool or spa.

Underground parking beneath the hotel at EUR 28 per night, no reservation needed, height limit 2.0 m. Plaka is largely pedestrian; the concierge sends arrival directions for the garage entrance on request.

Dogs up to 10 kg are welcome in Deluxe Rooms at EUR 35 per night, maximum one per room. Dogs are not admitted to the rooftop restaurant. Other animals are not accepted except certified assistance animals, which stay free.

A private transfer from Athens airport is EUR 70 per car for up to three guests, 40 to 50 minutes. The concierge confirms it once the flight number is received. Official taxis charge a fixed EUR 40 by day and EUR 55 at night.
The concierge recommends Strofi (rooftop taverna with Acropolis view, 8 minutes' walk), Nolan (modern Greek, 10 minutes' walk) and Diporto for a traditional lunch. Tables are booked by the concierge.

Two Deluxe Rooms are step-free with roll-in showers; the rooftop is reached by lift. Plaka's streets are steep and cobbled, which matters for wheelchair users; the concierge can arrange step-free routes to the Acropolis Museum. Access needs are recorded in a restricted trace to front office.

The Acropolis entrance is a 10-minute walk, Syntagma metro 7 minutes. Acropolis View Rooms face the hill and are quiet; Deluxe Rooms face a pedestrian lane with evening restaurant noise until about midnight.

Check-in at Aurel Comporta is from 16:00 and check-out is by 12:00. Luggage can be stored before check-in and after check-out, and guests may use the pool, spa and beach club from arrival; changing rooms and showers are in the spa. Reception is open 07:00 to 23:00, with a night porter after that.

Aurel Comporta has an outdoor pool heated from April to October, a fitness room open 06:00 to 22:00, a spa with treatment rooms and a thermal area, a beach club with a shuttle every 20 minutes, and complimentary Wi-Fi throughout. Breakfast is served 07:30 to 11:00. The restaurant serves lunch at the beach club and dinner at the main house.
Free parking on site for all guests, with electric charging at no extra cost. A car is recommended; Comporta has no public transport and the nearest town is 15 minutes' drive.

Dogs of any size are welcome in Dune Villas and Ocean Villas at EUR 50 per night, maximum two per villa, and may use the villa garden and the dog-friendly stretch of beach. Dogs are not accepted in Garden Rooms or in the pool area. Other animals are not accepted except certified assistance animals, which stay free.
A private transfer from Lisbon airport is EUR 180 per car for up to three guests, about 75 minutes. A minivan for up to six is EUR 260. The concierge confirms it once the flight number is received.

Spa treatments can be pre-booked by the concierge up to the day before arrival; popular afternoon slots in summer fill a week ahead. The thermal area is for guests aged 16 and over. Treatments cancelled with less than 24 hours' notice are charged in full.

The concierge recommends Sal (beachfront seafood, 10 minutes' drive), Cavalariça (modern Portuguese in the village) and Dona Bia for a traditional lunch. Tables are booked by the concierge; summer weekends need three to four days' notice.

Children of all ages are welcome. Cots fit in Dune Villas and Ocean Villas but not in Garden Rooms. A kids' club runs 10:00 to 17:00 in July and August for ages 4 to 12. Babysitting can be arranged with 24 hours' notice. The pool is unsupervised.

Two Garden Rooms and one Dune Villa are step-free with roll-in showers and are on the boardwalk to the main house. The beach is reached by a boardwalk and a beach wheelchair is available on request. Access needs are recorded in a restricted trace to front office.

Flexible bookings can be cancelled free of charge until 48 hours before arrival at city hotels and 72 hours before arrival at resorts during peak months (June to September, Christmas and Easter weeks). Later cancellations and no-shows are charged the first night. The cancellation deadline is always shown on the confirmation and counts in the hotel's local time.

Advance Purchase bookings are prepaid at the time of booking and non-refundable. Exceptions for bereavement, hospitalisation or official travel bans may be granted as a goodwill credit for a future stay, valid twelve months, only by a reservations manager and never by an agent. Agents acknowledge the request with the holding reply and pass the case to the manager the same day. We never ask a guest for medical or other proof in writing.

Flexible and Stay Longer bookings may be modified at the live published rate for the new dates or room, subject to availability. Advance Purchase bookings cannot be modified by the desk; a reservations manager may rebook as an exception. Rate differences are always charged or refunded at published rates, never waived. A modification is confirmed to the guest only after it is saved in the PMS.

Published rates on aurelhotels.com match the rates shown on online travel agencies. Agents may not discount, match or undercut a quoted OTA price under any circumstances. Direct bookers receive the Aurel Direct benefits instead: flexible check-out when available, a welcome drink and no booking fee. Non-public, corporate and negotiated rates require a reservations manager.

Card details must never be requested, accepted or stored from email, WhatsApp or OTA messaging. If a guest sends card details, they are removed from the message before it is stored and the guest receives a secure payment link generated by the payment gateway. Deposits and guarantees are taken only through that link or at the hotel.

Allergy, medical and accessibility details are special category data under GDPR. Record only what the hotel needs to deliver the stay safely, in a dedicated PMS trace with the restricted flag, never in free-text notes, OTA messages or email forwards. Confirm to the guest that we hold the information and say exactly who at the hotel will see it. Never promise an allergen-free kitchen; promise a briefed chef and a flagged table.

Requests for eight or more rooms, any event space, weddings, meetings or offsites are handled by the groups and events specialists, who respond within one working day with a single proposal covering rooms, meeting space and dining. The desk sends the fixed acknowledgement only and never quotes a rate or holds inventory for a group.

Early check-in is never guaranteed in advance, in writing or verbally. Front office confirms the evening before arrival based on departures and calls the guest if an early room is possible. Guaranteed early arrival requires booking and paying for the previous night. Luggage storage and use of the facilities are always available from arrival, and guests may change in the spa or pool area where the hotel has one.

Late check-out until 14:00 is complimentary when availability allows and is confirmed by front office on the morning of departure, not in advance. Later departures are charged half the nightly rate until 18:00 and a full night after that. Luxury programme guests have late check-out included subject to availability.

For anniversaries, birthdays, honeymoons and proposals the hotel provides a complimentary in-room celebration touch (a handwritten card with sparkling wine or a small cake) arranged by the hotel team when the desk logs the occasion in a trace. Room upgrades are at the hotel's discretion on the day of arrival and must never be promised in advance. Flowers, cakes with a message and photographers are arranged by the concierge at published prices.

Cots are complimentary for children under two and are subject to room compatibility shown on the room type. Extra beds are available only in rooms marked for three or more guests and are charged per night at the published supplement. Cots are set up before arrival when requested at least 24 hours ahead; the desk logs a housekeeping trace.

chunks.topic: Travel advisor and luxury programme bookings
chunks.text: Bookings made through recognised luxury programmes include a standard amenity set: daily breakfast, a hotel credit per stay, early check-in and late check-out subject to availability, and an upgrade on arrival subject to availability. Confirmations to advisors are issued by reservations staff, not by the AI agent, after checking the programme code on the booking. Repeat guests with six or more stays are flagged as VIP and handled by a senior agent.

Private transfers are arranged by the concierge and charged at the published rate per vehicle, shown in each hotel's handbook. A transfer is only confirmed once the concierge has the flight number and has sent written confirmation with the driver's details. The desk logs a concierge trace and tells the guest the concierge will confirm; it never confirms a car itself.

Children of all ages are welcome at every Aurel hotel except Aurel Santorini, which welcomes children aged twelve and over. Children under twelve stay free in their parents' room when using existing bedding. Babysitting can be arranged by the concierge with 24 hours' notice at published rates.
All rooms, suites and villas are non-smoking, including balconies and terraces. Designated outdoor smoking areas exist at every hotel. A deep-cleaning charge applies when a room has been smoked in.

Invoices are issued at check-out and can be addressed to a company with the VAT number given before departure. Copies of past invoices are sent by the hotel's front office within two working days; the desk logs a front-office trace rather than promising a date.

Items left behind are kept by housekeeping for three months. Returns are sent by courier at the guest's cost once the guest confirms the address and the item. The desk logs a housekeeping trace with a description; it never confirms an item has been found.

Check-in at Aurel Lisboa is from 15:00 and check-out is by 12:00. Luggage can be stored before check-in and after check-out, and guests may use the fitness room and bar from arrival. Reception is open 24 hours.

Aurel Lisboa has a fitness room open 24 hours, complimentary Wi-Fi throughout, a restaurant and a rooftop bar with views over the Tagus, open 17:00 to 01:00. Breakfast is served 07:00 to 10:30 in the restaurant, until 11:00 at weekends. There is no swimming pool or spa; in-room massages can be arranged by the concierge.

Valet parking is available at EUR 35 per night; hand the keys to the doorman on arrival, no reservation needed. Electric charging is available on request at no extra cost. The streets of Chiado are narrow and partly pedestrian, so we recommend arriving by taxi.

Dogs up to 12 kg are welcome in Deluxe and River View rooms at EUR 40 per night, maximum one per room. A bed and bowls are provided. Dogs are not admitted to the restaurant but are welcome on the rooftop terrace. Cats and other animals are not accepted except certified assistance animals, which stay free in any room.

A private transfer from Lisbon airport is EUR 60 per car for up to three guests, about 25 minutes. The concierge confirms it once the flight number is received. The airport metro reaches Baixa-Chiado in 30 minutes for guests who prefer it.

The concierge recommends Belcanto (two Michelin stars, 3 minutes' walk), Cervejaria Ramiro (seafood, 10 minutes by taxi) and Tágide (Portuguese, river view, 5 minutes' walk). Tables are booked by the concierge; popular places need two to three days' notice.

Two Deluxe Rooms are step-free with roll-in showers and grab rails; the lift serves every floor. The rooftop bar is reached by lift. Access needs are recorded in a restricted trace to front office so the right room is blocked before arrival.

The hotel is a 2-minute walk from Baixa-Chiado metro and the number 28 tram. Alfama, the castle and the riverfront are all within 20 minutes on foot. Street noise from the tram line is lowest in River View Rooms, which face the river.

Check-in at Aurel Madrid is from 15:00 and check-out is by 12:00. Luggage can be stored before check-in and after check-out, and guests may use the fitness room and bar from arrival. Reception is open 24 hours.

Aurel Madrid has a fitness room open 24 hours, complimentary Wi-Fi throughout, a restaurant and a courtyard bar open 12:00 to midnight. Breakfast is served 07:00 to 10:30, until 11:00 at weekends. There is no swimming pool or spa.

Underground garage beneath the hotel at EUR 38 per night, height limit 1.9 m, no reservation needed. Valet is available from the main entrance between 07:00 and 23:00. Madrid's low-emission zone covers the hotel; the concierge can advise on permits for non-resident cars.

Dogs up to 15 kg are welcome in Deluxe and Premier Rooms at EUR 40 per night, maximum one per room. Retiro park across the road allows dogs on a lead. Other animals are not accepted except certified assistance animals, which stay free.

A private transfer from Madrid-Barajas is EUR 75 per car for up to three guests, 30 to 45 minutes depending on traffic. The concierge confirms it once the flight number is received. Official taxis from the airport charge a fixed EUR 33 to the city centre.

The concierge recommends La Tasquería (modern Spanish, 10 minutes' walk), Horcher (classic, opposite the Retiro) and Casa Dani in the Mercado de la Paz for lunch. Madrid dines late; most kitchens open at 20:30.

Three Deluxe Rooms are step-free with roll-in showers; all public areas are reached by lift or ramp. Access needs are recorded in a restricted trace to front office so the right room is blocked before arrival.
The Prado is a 7-minute walk and the Retiro park is across the road. Retiro metro station is 3 minutes away. The hotel is quiet at night; rooms facing the courtyard are the quietest.

Check-in at Aurel Mallorca is from 15:00 and check-out is by 12:00. Luggage can be stored before check-in and after check-out, and guests may use the pool, spa and restaurant from arrival; changing rooms are in the spa. Reception is open 24 hours.

Aurel Mallorca has an outdoor pool, a fitness room open 06:00 to 22:00, a spa with treatment rooms and a thermal area, a restaurant and a terrace bar, and complimentary Wi-Fi throughout. Breakfast is served 07:30 to 11:00 on the terrace in summer. The pool is open 08:00 to 20:00 and is unheated.

Free parking on site for all guests. A car is recommended for exploring the Tramuntana; the hotel can arrange a rental delivered to the door. The road from Palma takes about 40 minutes and is winding.

Dogs up to 15 kg are welcome in Garden Rooms and Cliff Villas at EUR 45 per night, maximum one per room. Dogs are not accepted in Sea View Rooms or Family Suites and are not admitted to the pool terrace or restaurant. Other animals are not accepted except certified assistance animals, which stay free.
A private transfer from Palma airport is EUR 120 per car for up to three guests, about 45 minutes. The concierge confirms it once the flight number is received.

The kitchen can accommodate nut, gluten and dairy allergies and vegan diets with 24 hours' notice. Severe allergies are flagged to the executive chef and noted on the table card for every reservation during the stay, including breakfast. We never describe the kitchen as allergen-free; we promise a briefed chef and a flagged table.

Spa treatments can be pre-booked by the concierge up to the day before arrival. Guests under 16 are not admitted to the thermal area. Treatments cancelled with less than 24 hours' notice are charged in full.

The concierge recommends Es Racó d'es Teix (Michelin, 5 minutes' walk), Ca's Patró March (seafood at the cala, 15 minutes' walk down a steep path) and Sebastian (modern Mediterranean, in the village). Reservations are made by the concierge; in summer allow several days.

Children of all ages are welcome. Family Suites sleep two adults and two children; cots fit in Family Suites and Cliff Villas. The cliff paths and pool are unsupervised and not fenced, so young children need an adult with them outdoors. Babysitting with 24 hours' notice.

The site is terraced into a cliff and most routes involve steps. One Garden Room near reception is step-free with a roll-in shower and level access to the restaurant and pool. Sea View Rooms and the cala path are not suitable for wheelchairs. Access needs are recorded in a restricted trace to front office.

Check-in at Aurel Roma is from 15:00 and check-out is by 11:00. Luggage can be stored before check-in and after check-out, and guests may use the fitness room and bar from arrival. Reception is open 24 hours.

Aurel Roma has a fitness room open 24 hours, complimentary Wi-Fi throughout, a restaurant and a rooftop bar open 18:00 to midnight from April to October. Breakfast is served 07:00 to 10:30. There is no swimming pool or spa.

There is no on-site parking. A partner garage 300 m away charges EUR 45 per day; the concierge can reserve a space with the car's registration number. The hotel sits inside Rome's restricted traffic zone (ZTL); the concierge must register the registration number before arrival or the car will be fined.
Pets are not accepted at Aurel Roma, except certified assistance animals, which stay free in any room. The concierge can recommend a nearby pet hotel.

A private transfer from Fiumicino is EUR 80 per car for up to three guests, 45 to 60 minutes; from Ciampino EUR 70. The concierge confirms it once the flight number is received. Official taxis charge a fixed EUR 55 from Fiumicino to the centre.
The concierge recommends Armando al Pantheon (Roman classics, 5 minutes' walk, book two weeks ahead), Pierluigi (seafood, 6 minutes' walk) and Roscioli for lunch. Tables are booked by the concierge.

The building is sixteenth century; one Deluxe Room on the first floor is fully step-free with a roll-in shower and is reached by the lift. The rooftop bar has three steps. Access needs are recorded in a restricted trace to front office so the right room is blocked before arrival.
Piazza Navona and the Pantheon are 3 minutes on foot, the Vatican 20 minutes. Rooms facing the inner courtyard are the quietest; Terrace Suites face the street and have a private terrace.

Check-in at Aurel Santorini is from 15:00 and check-out is by 11:00. Luggage can be stored before check-in and after check-out, and guests may use the pool, spa and restaurant from arrival. Porters carry luggage down the caldera steps. Reception is open 07:00 to 23:00, with a night porter after that.

Aurel Santorini has an outdoor infinity pool, a fitness room open 06:00 to 22:00, a spa with treatment rooms and a thermal area, a restaurant and a sunset bar, and complimentary Wi-Fi throughout. Breakfast is served 07:30 to 11:00 and can be served on the suite terrace. The hotel closes from November to March.

Free parking in the hotel car park at the top of Oia, a 5-minute walk and about 90 steps from the hotel; porters collect luggage from the car park. Rental cars, quads and scooters can be delivered there by the concierge's partner.
Pets are not accepted at Aurel Santorini, except certified assistance animals, which stay free. The caldera steps and open terraces make the site unsuitable for animals.

A private transfer from Santorini airport or the Athinios port is EUR 70 per car for up to three guests, 30 to 40 minutes. Confirmed by the concierge once the flight or ferry number is received. Santorini has very few taxis in summer, so we recommend pre-booking.

Spa treatments and in-suite couples' massages can be pre-booked by the concierge up to the day before arrival. Guests under 16 are not admitted to the thermal area. Treatments cancelled with less than 24 hours' notice are charged in full.

The concierge recommends Ammoudi Fish Tavern (by the water, 300 steps down), Lauda (fine dining, 3 minutes' walk) and Metaxi Mas near Exo Gonia (traditional, 20 minutes by car). Sunset tables in Oia must be booked a week ahead in summer.

Sea View Rooms and Plunge Pool Suites face the caldera and have a private terrace. Cave Rooms face the courtyard. The view category is guaranteed; the specific room is allocated on the day of arrival.

Due to the cliffside terraces and unfenced plunge pools, Aurel Santorini welcomes children aged 12 and over only. Cots and extra beds are not available. Families with younger children are offered Aurel Algarve or Aurel Comporta instead.

Aurel Santorini is reached by about 90 steps from the car park and all rooms involve further steps; there are no lifts and no step-free rooms. The hotel is not suitable for wheelchair users or guests with limited mobility, and the desk says so plainly rather than recording a request the hotel cannot meet.
